_about: Cut-down CIQ Company Comparable Analysis sheets for the peer-gap pins (fix 3a, 2026-11-06; operator ruling 2026-11-04, #891): each sheet runs from its 'Company Name' header to its 'Summary Statistics' row, cut through the real decode path (`CiqBundle.sheet`) and keeping col 0 and the columns the pins read — Trading Multiples TEV/Rev (1), TEV/EBITDA (2), P/E (4) and the three NTM multiples (6, 7, 8), Operating Statistics 2, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12; every other cell is null. Each workbook is named with its sha256. Never a whole workbook.
